labels.title: The Value Proposition Canvas
labels.customerSegment: Individuals managing personal finances and life records

customerJobs.title: Keep an account safe
customerJobs.note: Sign in and stay signed in without exposing credentials or sessions.

customerJobs.title: Organize finances and life records
customerJobs.note: Hold money tracking and personal journaling in one trusted place.

customerJobs.title: Approve sensitive changes
customerJobs.note: Confirm identity again before changing passwords or security settings.

pains.title: Weak credential storage
pains.note: Older hashing schemes are easier to attack with brute force.

pains.title: Stolen or replayed sessions
pains.note: Long-lived tokens in cookies can be stolen or abused through cross-site requests.

pains.title: No visibility into sign-in activity
pains.note: Users and owners cannot see failed logins or session changes.

gains.title: Confidence in account security
gains.note: Credentials and sessions are protected before sensitive data is stored.

gains.title: Traceable activity
gains.note: Sign-in and session events can be reviewed.

gains.title: A foundation to build on
gains.note: Finance and growth features can be added on top of a secure base.

productsAndServices.title: Authentication Engine
productsAndServices.note: Signup, signin, refresh, and logout with Argon2 and dual-token issuance.

productsAndServices.title: Session Lifecycle
productsAndServices.note: Database-backed sessions with rotating refresh hashes and CSRF verification.

productsAndServices.title: Security Event Log
productsAndServices.note: Stored login, logout, and refresh events with IP and user-agent.

productsAndServices.title: Documentation Site
productsAndServices.note: 30 Docusaurus pages covering architecture, domain specs, and sequence diagrams.

painRelievers.title: Argon2
painRelievers.note: Passwords and refresh token hashes are stored with a memory-hard algorithm.

painRelievers.title: Single-use rotation
painRelievers.note: Every refresh issues a new token and rejects reuse, revoking the session on replay.

painRelievers.title: CSRF token pairing
painRelievers.note: Refresh requires a matching client token, blocking cross-site refresh attempts.

gainCreators.title: Immutable security events
gainCreators.note: Login outcomes and refresh rotations are recorded for later review.

gainCreators.title: Sudo session model
gainCreators.note: Time-bounded step-up authentication is modeled for sensitive actions.

gainCreators.title: Structured logging
gainCreators.note: JSON request logs make auditing and debugging searchable.
